Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:

  • compartment_id - (Required) The OCID of the compartment to create the data source in.
  • knowledge_base_id - (Required) The OCID of the parent knowledge base.
  • display_name - (Optional) (Updatable) A user-friendly name. Does not have to be unique, and it's changeable. Avoid entering confidential information.
  • description - (Optional) (Updatable) A description of the data source.
  • metadata - (Optional) (Updatable) Key-value pairs to allow additional configurations.
  • data_source_config - (Required) (Updatable) The data source configuration.
    • data_source_config_type - (Required) (Updatable) The type of data source configuration.
    • should_enable_multi_modality - (Optional) (Updatable) Whether ingestion should include multi-modality content such as images.
    • object_storage_prefixes - (Optional) (Updatable) The locations of data items in Object Storage.
      • namespace_name - (Required) (Updatable) The Object Storage namespace.
      • bucket_name - (Required) (Updatable) The Object Storage bucket.
      • prefix - (Optional) (Updatable) The file or folder prefix.
  • freeform_tags - (Optional) (Updatable) Free-form tags for this resource.
  • defined_tags - (Optional) (Updatable) Defined tags for this resource.
